mapper.sql: w.id, w.title, w.content, w.type, w.priority, w.due_date, w.status, w.counselor_id, w.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , u.real_name AS counselor_name FROM work_reminder w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON w.counselor_id = u.id WHERE w.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_reminder (title, content, type, priority, due_date, status, counselor_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{priority}, #{dueDate}, #{status}, #{counselorId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM work_reminder WHERE status = #{status}
